sample_name.errorMessage: sample_name may only contain letters, digits, dot, underscore, and hyphen. These characters are interpolated into shell/sed commands (e.g. BAM @RG reheadering and alignment read groups), so other characters are disallowed to avoid command injection and corruption.

truth_sample_name.description: Optional sample name used to match truth resources and select the sample for vcfeval. When omitted, the workflow's existing sample-name inference is used.
truth_sample_name.errorMessage: truth_sample_name may only contain letters, digits, dot, underscore, and hyphen.

sample_type.description: Optional sample type for somatic tumor-normal model selection. Defaults to auto-detect when omitted or when paired samples disagree. Ignored for non-tumor-normal samples.

reporter_vcf_tumor_sample.description: Sample name in the reporter VCF that corresponds to the tumor sample. Required when reporter_vcf is provided.

reporter_vcf_normal_sample.description: Sample name in the reporter VCF that corresponds to the normal sample. Optional.

bam_type.description: State of pre-aligned BAM/CRAM inputs. When omitted, defaults to 'no_dedup' so the configured deduplication strategy is applied. sas_markdup inputs are re-marked because SAS duplicate marking is not reliable for every library type. Ignored for basecall and FASTQ inputs.
